thought.text: The harness recovered. The login page fetched (200) but the `execution` field extraction missed. Let me inspect the actual form structure:

reasoning_content:
Progress! This time the script was executed:
- auth-page=200 (login page fetched)
- execution-set=no (the regex didn't find the execution hidden field — maybe a different format)
- login-post=302, redirect to login-actions/authenticate?client_id=local-client&tab_id=... — this redirect means the form was processed. A 302 to the same authenticate page with tab_id usually indicates a login attempt (if credentials are wrong, Keycloak redirects back with an error parameter, or displays an error on the page).

The execution field is needed. Let me examine the HTML structure of the login page and correctly extract the execution parameter, then complete the flow and check the redirect result. Also, I'll check for error parameters in the final URL.
